full_name: David Bezmozgis | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2011–2012 Fiction & Poetry Lisa Goldberg Fellow Independent Writer (Canada)
bio: David Bezmozgis, a writer and filmmaker, is the author of the collection Natasha and Other Stories (Farrar, Straus and Giroux, 2004) and the novel The Free World (Farrar, Straus and Giroux, 2011).
